decisions.statement: A page type is handed to the mechanical change declaring a property on one.
The declaration and the part are that change's one answer.
The count is handed in named `max-count` and handed on named `maxCount`.
`required` and `many` are handed in as text and handed on as truths.
A refusal from that change is the refusal this act gives.
The generator writes the page type's own type again from what this leaves.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
No change but that one rung is reached.

definition: one page property declared on one page type
